name: Idea X-Ray
need: Without it, people burn real money on ideas they never tested — no score, no fixes, no warning before the first dollar.
tesla: The score path — 64 → 71 → 58 — watching your idea get more viable or stay a money trap. A quiz gives you a number; this watches your back for months.
what: Paste any business idea; it grades it 0–100 across 8 real factors, tells you what's strong and what to fix before you spend, and tracks the idea's score trajectory as you learn.

name: Dream Plan Builder
need: Without it, big goals die — no plan, no weekly follow-through, and no idea what to actually do this week.
tesla: The This Week view — type your dream once, and every Sunday the app tells you exactly what this week means. Nobody ever made the one button that runs your whole goal.
what: Type a big goal; get a dated step-by-step plan with phases, budget split, week-by-week actions, and 8 milestones with a live progress bar.

name: Story Spark
need: Without it, parents face the bedtime-story panic every single night — an empty head, and a kid who hates repeats.
tesla: A parent realizing they will never run out of bedtime stories again — fresh, personal, with a lesson, in 5 seconds, plus a library of favorites their kid asks for by name.
what: Original multi-chapter bedtime stories in seconds — your kid as the hero, age-matched wording, your chosen lesson woven into the ending, never repeated.
